meta.name: opportunity-solution-tree
meta.description: Build an Opportunity Solution Tree from outcomes to opportunities, solutions, and tests. Use when a stakeholder request needs problem framing before you decide what to build.

copy.tagline: 将利益相关者请求转化为机会解决方案树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发前先系统性地框架化问题
copy.tagline_en: Turn stakeholder requests into an Opportunity Solution Tree
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame problems before deciding what to build

howto.what: Claude会引导你通过一组问题，从模糊的产品请求中提取商业目标，找出客户问题（机会），列出方案，并推荐最值得先验证的POC。
howto.when: 当你提出一个利益相关者请求或产品创意，需要先理清问题再决定做什么时触发。

say.text: 我们收到用户反馈说注册转化低，帮我用机会解决方案树分析。
有个利益相关者想新增导出功能，先帮我做问题框定。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through a series of questions to extract business goals from vague product requests, identify customer problems (opportunities), generate solutions, and recommend the best proof-of-concept (POC) to test first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you raise a stakeholder request or product initiative that needs problem framing before deciding what to build.

say_en.text: Users report low trial conversion—help me analyze with an Opportunity Solution Tree.
say_en.note: Claude starts asking questions to extract the outcome.

say_en.text: A stakeholder wants a new export feature. Help me frame the problem first.
say_en.note: Claude enters the OST guided flow.
